name: How long will I be without a shower during replacement?

mainEntity.name: How long will I be without a shower during replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward shower-to-shower replacement can be relatively quick, but a custom tile shower, relocated plumbing, damaged framing, or delayed materials can extend the schedule. Context: Published industry estimates commonly describe prefab installations as faster than custom tile work; tile also requires time for waterproofing, setting, grouting, and curing. Key factors: demolition findings; inspection timing; material availability; glass-door measurement; and whether the bathroom remains usable. Practical guidance: Ask for a stage-by-stage schedule rather than one broad duration, and confirm when the shower will be unavailable. Elite Remodeling & Design’s design-through-construction approach lets layout, selections, permitting needs, and construction sequencing be considered together.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple same-footprint replacement may take much less time than a custom tile project. The schedule can grow when plumbing moves, hidden damage appears, inspections are needed, or custom glass and materials arrive late. Ask for a written schedule with milestones and the expected period without shower access.
